messages:
Maya (docs): Quick one — spotted a small bucket of runbook images returning 403 in staging. Thinking we should add a lightweight frontmatter field `custodian` (single display name) so ownership is discoverable. Who can take custody for a few runbooks this week?
Sam (platform): I can take infra-runbooks. Do we have a canonical list to act on?
Maya (docs): I pulled a quick scan:
```
$ rg "\.(png|jpg|svg)" docs/runbooks | rg staging | sed -n '1,50p'
docs/runbooks/kv-cache-ops.md:![kv diag](https://staging.cdn.redwood.local/images/kv-diag.png)
docs/runbooks/autoscale-guide.md:![scale chart](https://staging.cdn.redwood.local/images/scale-ops.svg)
docs/runbooks/pg-recovery.md:![pg hint](https://staging.cdn.redwood.local/images/pg-hint.jpg)
```
Maya (docs): InfraBot's scan also flagged 12 assets earlier today — pasted below.
InfraBot: scan result: 12 assets with 403 in staging, 3 in production. See /internal/tools/asset-scan/6142 for details.
Jeremy (oncall): hit kv-cache-ops during the morning incident, can be temp owner while we update frontmatter.
Alex (infra): I can claim `kv-cache-ops.md` and `autoscale-guide.md`. Sam can you add a quick CODEOWNERS fallback? If not, custodian frontmatter is fine.
Sam (platform): I prefer explicit frontmatter so we don't have to maintain CODEOWNERS churn. Agree to add `custodian: Alex (infra)` to those.
Maya (docs): Plan:
- add `custodian` frontmatter to affected runbooks
- open a single PR per change with a short blurb in the description: "custodian: NAME — fixes staging 403 evidence: <scan link>"
- run a smoke test before merge: `curl -I $IMG_URL` (expect 200)
Maya (docs): Here's a tiny sed snippet to inject frontmatter for batch edits (adapt per file):
```
# add custodian to top of file if missing
for f in docs/runbooks/*.md; do
  if ! rg "^custodian:\s" "$f" > /dev/null; then
    sed -i "1s/^/custodian: Alex (infra)\n/" "$f"
  fi
done
```
Alex (infra): Nice. I'll prep a PR for the two I claimed and run the smoke tests.
Jeremy (oncall): For `pg-recovery.md` can someone from storage own that? @Sam any preference?
Sam (platform): Not my wheelhouse. @Maya could you ping storage team or list possible custodians in the PR?
Maya (docs): Yep — I'll add a short checklist in the PR template: custodian, smoke-test (curl), scan ref, and a small QA note.
Alex (infra): Ping me in the PR review when ready, will do a quick sanity pass.
Maya (docs): One more ask — can we add a nightly job to rerun InfraBot's asset-scan and post a thread to #docs with a short summary? That way we get early nudges.
Sam (platform): 👍 yes, we can schedule it. I'll file a tiny infra ticket and link it in the PR.
Maya (docs): OK awesome. I'll open the first PRs for the two files and tag everyone. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Alex (infra): :thumbsup:
InfraBot: pinned report https://internal/reports/asset-scan/6142 (summary: 12 staging 403s, 3 prod 403s).
Maya (docs): PRs opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1987 (kv-cache-ops), https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1988 (autoscale-guide) — tagging @Sam @Alex @Jeremy for quick review.
Jeremy (oncall): will glance tonight. If anything blocks runbook fixes during an incident, assign me as temp custodian.
Sam (platform): will add infra ticket: INFRA-987 (nightly asset-scan -> #docs).
Maya (docs): thanks — closing the loop here. If anyone else spots 403s, drop them in this thread and we'll batch.
